title: A pharmacist's name tag shows at least the first name and a listed title
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(19), a pharmacist shall wear a name tag with at least his or her first name and the title "Pharmacist", "Registered Pharmacist", or "R.Ph.".
exam_relevance: Tests the minimum content of a pharmacist's name tag: at least the first name and one of the three listed titles.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
